title: Worst Scam Ever. Should be penalized
body: This is the worst scam ever. I never downloaded the app, never logged in and in a matter of just 3 months they charged me $100. It was supposed to be a trial but on the same day they charged me $11, the next month $29.99 “for a lifetime suscription” and the third month $79.99 … it’s a fraud. They’re getting advantage of people with a disability. I already reported it in Apple.
author: Melrodz84
